signal_text: A blog post (dated November 2025) states that many Gumroad users faced delayed payouts, poor customer support, and account suspensions without clear reasons, and that some people struggled to get their money back.
subject_exact: Author-reported pattern of delayed payouts, poor support, and unexplained account suspensions among Gumroad users
extraction_notes: 'Many users' and 'Some people' are vague quantifiers — no specific count provided. Author is summarizing reported experiences of others, not their own. Source November 2025.
